name: Isocarboxazid
summary: Isocarboxazid, sold under the brand name Marplan among others, is a non-selective irreversible monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI) of the hydrazine class. Along with phenelzine and tranylcypromine, it is one of the three classic irreversible, non-selective MAOIs used as antidepressants in modern psychiatric practice.
